# JavaScript (Node.js) project

A ready-to-run project exported from the [Programiz online compiler][programiz] - open it there to run or edit it online.

## What you need

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (18 or newer)

## Files

```
main.js         your program
package.json    project metadata and the `start` script
```

## Run it

Open a terminal in this folder and run:

```sh
npm start

# or directly:
node main.js
```

Your code uses `import`/`export`, so `package.json` sets `"type": "module"`.
